steps.content: The main gate of the villa.

steps.speaker: Cowardly Guard
steps.content: Are we under attack again? I heard many other places are under attack too. How did this wave come so fast?

steps.speaker: Anxious Guard
steps.content: Shhhh! Don't be distracted and keep quiet. Watch every corner closely. Assassins might break in at any time.

steps.speaker: Cowardly Guard
steps.content: Wh-what's the use? We're facing off a Sinner... a monster!

steps.speaker: Cowardly Guard
steps.content: What about the FAC? Didn't they say they'll send someone to keep this place safe? Where is our help?

Rahu is in no hurry to enter. She had already scouted out the structure of the building last night, and is hiding in the most discreet corner. She pays close attention to what's going on inside, patiently waiting for an opportunity.
What she's waiting for soon arrives.

steps.speaker: Anxious Guard
steps.content: Assassin! It's the assassin!!! The assassin has broken into the villa!!! Help!!
Rahu leaps out into the courtyard. The guards no longer look at her with disgust and contempt, and are now screaming for her help. No one questions her unruly intrusion or late arrival.

The villa's front gate hadn't been breached, Rahu immediately spots the assassin. The assassin had cleverly hidden the face, but the moment the assassin sees Rahu, the surprise and disgust are exposed for all to see.
